AA

Graduate Engineer Trainee – Environment

Experience

Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) – Environment — The Ramco Cements Limited July 2025 – Present

- Assisted in environmental compliance and securing statutory clearances (EC, CTE & CTO) for cement plants, mines and quarries covering major and minor minerals.

- Participated in surveys and inspections conducted by statutory bodies and third-party verification audits, including the BRSR Assurance Audit and an inter-plant environmental audit.

- Maintained 100% regulatory compliance while boosting efficiency by 33% - Submitted annual returns of hazardous and biomedical waste documentation 10 days early.

- Supported environmental monitoring for cement and captive thermal power plants following CPCB guidelines for source emission monitoring, CEMS guideline 2018.

- Facilitated statutory groundwater clearances by assisting in the procurement of No Objection Certificates (NOC).

- Conducted industrial water audits and monitored operations for DM plants, STP and ETP to ensure strict compliance with effluent standards, while actively contributing to field bathymetric surveys.

- Monitored continuous environmental performance and compliance data using CEMS, CAAQMS, and CEQMS.

- Contributed to the operational optimization of the kiln, cooler, and mills, achieving a 10% reduction in Particulate Matter (PM) emissions (from 20 mg/Nm³ to <=18 mg/Nm³).

- Managed BRSR data analytics and evaluated compliance frameworks related to carbon, plastic, and green credit programs to support corporate sustainability goals.

GRACC Intern — Inspire Clean Energy Pvt. Ltd. April 2023 – July 2023

- Evaluated solar PV plant efficiency by analyzing string current data and Performance Ratio (PR), alongside managing strict safety and maintenance documentation (TBT, PTW, PPE).

Projects / Deliverables

Modelling and Optimization of an Intensified Water Electrolysis Integrated Tri-Reforming Coupled Methanol Production Process

Developed and optimized a methanol production model using Aspen Plus and Python.

- Recognized with the Best Paper Presentation Award at ICCEAS 2025.

- Authored a published research article in E3S Web of Conferences.

Development of a Decision Support System for Watershed Morphology

Developed an interactive calculator using Python and Qt Designer that streamlines the calculation of essential watershed morphology.

Education

M.Tech. in Energy and Environmental Engineering

National Institute of Technology, Rourkela, August 2023 – May 2025

CGPA: 9.42 / 10.00

B.Tech. in Energy and Environmental Engineering

AEC&RI, Tamil Nadu Agricultural University, Coimbatore, August 2019 – July 2023

CGPA: 8.67 / 10.00

Certifications & Licenses

- Sustainability and Corporate ESG – Reliance Foundation, under NSDC

- ISO :2015 – Environmental Management Systems – Alison

- ESG Masterclass – PROIndia (Webinar)

Professional Summary

Environmental Engineer with one year of industry experience in regulatory compliance, environmental data analysis and Environmental Management Systems (EMS). Skilled in monitoring sewage and effluent treatment operations, driven by a strong commitment to corporate sustainability and continuous improvement.

Core Skills

Platforms: OpenLCA, Power BI, Aspen Plus, PVsyst

Methods: Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA), Regulatory Compliance & Permitting, ESG Strategy & Reporting, Carbon Accounting & GHG Management, Environmental Management Systems (ISO :2015), Integrated Waste Management, Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), Renewable Energy (Solar PV) Design, Wastewater Treatment (STP/ETP) Engineering, Process Simulation & Optimization

Soft Skills: Open-minded, Rational thinking, Time management, Problem-solving

Awards / Honors

- Best Paper Presentation Award, ICCEAS-25

- Student Project Scheme Winner - Tamil Nadu State Council for Science and Technology

- GATE Qualified Candidate, 2023

- Organizer, ECOFEST’23 – an international conference

- Inter-Collegiate Hockey Tournament – Zonal Winner and Inter-Zonal Runner-Up

Project Coordinator – ESG Advisory — NEPRA Environmental Solutions and Technologies Pvt.Ltd. Mar 2025 – Present

HM

LCA Analyst

Experience

LCA Analyst — L&T Technology Services Dec 2022 – Present

- Conducted Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) to evaluate Scope s ensuring compliance with ISO /s.

- Defined the study goal and scope, specifying the functional unit, and set system boundaries for accurate environmental impact analysis.

- Gathered and evaluated data across all product life cycle stages, including manufacturing, distribution, installation, usage, and end-of-life disposal.

- Collaborated with internal and external stakeholders to review Bill of Materials (BOM) and identify data gaps in material and process selection.

- Validated calculation and methodologies; developed product models in LCA tools for impact assessment.

- Identified environmental hotspots and recommended strategies or alternative materials to reduce overall product environmental footprint.

- Published Product Environmental Profile (PEP) and generated Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) Reports in adherence to PCR rules and ISO /s.

- Published 40 EPDs on PEP Eco-Passport, with 10+ EPDs in progress.

- Developed automated Excel templates to streamline processes including calculation of extrapolation factors and waste distribution scenarios.

Projects / Deliverables

Fabrication of Dual Mode Scooty

Designed and developed a dual-mode scooty capable of operating on both petrol and electric power modes.

- Integrated an internal combustion engine with an electric motor to enable flexible mode switching based on requirement.

- Allowed seamless transition between modes, improving usability in different driving conditions.

- Supported reduced dependency on a single energy source and promoted practical adoption of dual-mode vehicles.

Design Optimization of Mono Leaf Spring using MMC

Designed and analyzed a mono leaf spring using SolidWorks and ANSYS Workbench to evaluate structural performance.

- Focused on replacing conventional stainless steel with a metal matrix composite (P100 Gr/6061 Al) for improved efficiency.

- Conducted finite element analysis under varying loads to compare stress, strain, and deformation characteristics.

- Demonstrated reduced weight and improved load-bearing capacity using composite material, followed by design optimization.

- Successfully published as a research paper.

Box Transport Mechanism

Fabricated a box transport mechanism using scrap materials and wood for cost-effective material handling.

- Operated on a crank and link mechanism to convert rotary motion into linear motion for moving boxes.

- Capable of being driven manually or using a 24V electric motor with chain and gear arrangement.

- Ensured durability and smooth operation with guided movement using mild steel linkages and frame.

- Capable of transporting small loads (1 – 2 kg) efficiently, demonstrating a simple and sustainable handling solution.
